title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join a well-established law firm in Chester, Cheshire. This is a full-time, permanent job position offering a salary of up to £29,000, flexible hybrid working, 25 days' annual leave, an additional paid day off for your birthday, paid closure between Christmas and New Year, Simply healthcare with dental and optical cover and early finish on Fridays. You will join a close-knit property team, supporting solicitors across a varied commercial property workload with some residential conveyancing crossover and the opportunity to continue developing your legal experience.

Role Responsibilities

As a Commercial Property Legal Assistant, you will work closely with solicitors in a collaborative property team, providing day-to-day support across commercial property matters and some residential conveyancing work. Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting solicitors with the progression of commercial property matters and related property transactions.
- Assisting with work connected to real estate finance and bridging finance matters as part of the team's wider commercial property caseload.
- Providing support on residential conveyancing matters where these form part of the supervising solicitor's mixed workload.
- Keeping up to date with the progress of matters and working closely with the wider team to ensure information is shared effectively.
- Completing a mixture of substantive legal support and administrative tasks appropriate to a Legal Assistant position.
- Working collaboratively within a close-knit team and providing reliable support to fee earners across a busy property workload.

Person Specification

This Commercial Property Legal Assistant job would suit someone who already has practical legal support experience within property and is looking to build broader exposure within a commercial property team. Applications are welcomed from candidates who can demonstrate the following:
- Previous experience supporting fee earners within commercial property, residential conveyancing or another closely related property environment.
- An interest in developing broader commercial property experience, with exposure to both commercial and residential property particularly useful.
- The ability to manage a varied workload accurately and stay organised while supporting multiple matters.

Benefits and Rewards

This Commercial Property Legal Assistant opportunity offers a supportive working environment together with a strong package of confirmed benefits. The successful Commercial Property Legal Assistant will also benefit from:
- A salary of up to £29,000 dependent on experience.
- Flexible hybrid working after probation.
- 25 days' annual leave.
- An additional paid day off for your birthday.
- Paid closure between Christmas and New Year.
- A Simplyhealth healthcare cash plan, with support towards costs such as dental and optical treatment.
- Access to a perks and discounts platform through the healthcare scheme.
- Early finish on Fridays of 4pm.
- Regular staff social activities throughout the year.
- Opportunities for career progression and professional development within the firm.

About the Law Firm

This is an established and forward-thinking, Lexcel-accredited law firm with a strong presence across Cheshire and North Wales. The firm provides a broad range of services to individuals and businesses and has a busy commercial and property offering. It promotes a supportive and collaborative working environment, with an emphasis on client service, professional development and giving people opportunities to progress their careers. The Commercial Property Legal Assistant will be based in the firm's Chester, Cheshire office and work closely with an experienced property team.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Commercial Property Legal Assistant job, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group or call for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Family Paralegal
description:
FAMILY LAW PARALEGAL, 3+ YEARS' EXPERIENCE, CHESHIRE - Develop Your Family Law Career with a Respected and Supportive Legal Practice

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Family Law Paralegal to join a well-established and highly regarded law firm in Cheshire.

Working alongside experienced Family Lawyers, you will support a varied caseload while developing your own fee-earning experience within a friendly and supportive team.

The Role

You will provide hands-on support across a broad range of Family Law matters, with responsibilities including:
- Supporting solicitors with the management of their caseloads
- Undertaking fee-earning work under supervision
- Drafting applications, statements, correspondence and other legal documents
- Preparing cases and Court bundles
- Attending client meetings, conferences and hearings where appropriate
- Liaising with clients, Counsel and other professionals
- Managing deadlines, diaries and case progression
- Assisting with legal aid applications and billing
- Supporting business development and professional referral relationships

The Candidate

Applications are sought from Family Law Paralegals or Legal Assistants with a minimum of 3 years' relevant experience.

You will have:
- Strong experience within a Family Law team
- Good knowledge of family law procedures and processes
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Strong attention to detail
- A confident, personable and compassionate approach to client care
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team
- A proactive attitude and strong work ethic

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join an established firm that genuinely values quality client care, teamwork and professional development.

You will gain exposure to a varied Family Law caseload, work closely with experienced lawyers and have the opportunity to develop your fee-earning skills within a supportive environment.

If you're an experienced Family Law Paralegal looking for a role where you can build on your existing experience and take the next step in your career, this could be the opportunity for you.

To apply contact Melanie Daly at eNL on or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion quoting Job Ref: 5319 .

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications within 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE and salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever their ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims on behalf of a number of Public Sector clients.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle a variety of casualty/personal injury claims through to settlement
- Verify policy cover/validity
- Log and record all claims digitally
- Investigate allocated claims either from desk or instructed by the team of loss adjusters
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Make decision on liability and negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience working in the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Sector
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- The ability or understand insurance policy wordings and the insurance market
- Knowledge of civil procedure rules and the claims portal
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on Offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more

description: Working Part time: 19.5 hours per week We are seeking a motivated and compassionate Children's Ward Clerk to join our busy paediatric team. You will be responsible for managing patient information, supporting admissions and discharges, handling telephone enquiries, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of ward administration. Excellent communication, organisational, and IT skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. This role requires a friendly, professional approach and a commitment to delivering a high standard of service to children, young people, and their families. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure all information is entered correctly onto Trust electronic systems.
